desc: Derive the exact DP recurrence and prove the swap-cost formula (L - count_v) for gathering value v in a block.
Implement the dynamic programming solution to compute the minimum operations for each test case.
Optimize the DP transitions using a hash map to track last occurrences of values.
Implement a function to read input and parse test cases.
Write the output for each test case.
Verify the solution against the provided sample inputs to ensure correctness.
Test edge cases, such as all elements equal or all elements distinct.
Analyze time complexity to confirm it meets constraints (should be O(N) per test case).
